action.description: start a scan of a folder, or step an existing one.

path.description: start: the folder to scan, as the identity's own tools name it — relative to its home, or absolute inside a folder its operator granted it (Settings → Sandbox).

exclude.description: start: gitignore-style patterns to leave out, relative to path.

include_tests.description: start: judge test files too (default false). In a large Go tree tests are often most of the files — over two thirds of AII OS's — and each file costs about two Jev calls, so include them when the tests themselves are what you want measured.

max_files.description: start: stop after this many files (default 5000).

scan_id.description: step: the scan to advance; start: an optional name for the new scan (letters, digits, _ and -).
